window: Final five deliveries; single integrated acceptance window after implementation and targeted regression.
continuation_reason: New source033e8e79 after bounded decoded-cache recency change; final five request, not a continuation of canceled O6v4 samples.
native_read_process_scope: one dataset preparation per independent profile process, exact selected query list; each query retains three warmups and ten owning-output samples
contract_case_unit: one isolated workload family in a private process, at most 30 minutes including setup; failed/inconclusive families retained independently
extended_sampling: at most two independent 100-sample processes when preregistered uncertainty rule applies

resources.durability: default sync and acknowledgements; never disabled

resource_notes: Per-file and Kuzu virtual database mapping caps are stricter than the production 1TiB maximum; the identical 2GiB OS per-file cap applies to every engine.
6GiB address-space cap implies a physical resident cap but is not a container/RSS accounting equivalence. Native charged class budgets remain separately reported.

isolated_family_policy.maintenance: three warmup windows excluded, then ten measured windows with 100 durable batch inserts each; 1000 measured insert observations per process
isolated_family_policy.other_families: full-size semantic and capability observations; one-pass operation timings do not satisfy repeated latency gates; after an unchanged family fails or exhausts 30 minutes, later rounds record the same unmeasurable dependency without repeating the failed workload
isolated_family_policy.prior_dynamic_attempt: 30-minute cutoff, inconclusive; no full-size all-family pass assumed
isolated_family_policy.ordering: maintenance first, then documented family order; three rotating engine orders per family

known_native_budget_limits.aggregate_100000_groups_owning_output: Observed fixed QUERY-budget rejection. Validate every typed group/count via bounded partitions and preserve the full-output denial as unsupported N/A; no successful latency sample or ratio is inferred. Skewed groups and other failures are not exempt.

untimed_fixture_protocol: Committed-prefix continuation is disclosed in each fixture manifest. Original prefixes use 1000-row transactions; remaining fixture-only suffixes may use bounded 5000-row transactions. No import timing or fresh final-version import claim; final consumers are revalidated before use.
frozen_control_failure_policy: One failed or timed-out deterministic family/profile is retained; later unchanged independent slots are marked unmeasurable, never success.
prepared_read_protocol: Both native consumers clone identical prepared file; existing frozen-control import failures remain failures and are not repaired/reclassified. Input producer source6a and mixed-batch preparation history retained. Formal queries use exact full-result oracles; every failed consumer remains failed.

delete_protocol.query: MATCH (n:Churn) DELETE n RETURN 1 AS deleted
delete_protocol.change: Align explicit scalar outputs; preserve public native implicit full-result semantics. Do not pool old no-return/implicit-result failures or Kuzu-only timings.

progress_logging: One JSON line after each complete window, outside engine-operation timers; identical observational role on both engines.
baseline_version_rule: The original source6a baseline remains separately versioned; no mixed-version overall performance claim.
shared_read_input_policy: Both native consumers clone identical prepared file; existing frozen-control import failures remain failures and are not repaired/reclassified. Input producer source6a and mixed-batch preparation history retained. Formal queries use exact full-result oracles; every failed consumer remains failed.
formal_read_profiles: indexed (medium only; unsupported and failures retained)
new_acceptance: No automatic acceptance: review primary/protection/resource/steady-state gates separately. Failed/inconclusive cases never become passes.
performance_limitations: AS/RSS scope remains as in previous protocol; no claim of 6GiB cgroup equivalence.
Native IPC and Kuzu Python have disclosed unequal entry/trace overheads.
Contract families except maintenance have descriptive operation timings, not invented 3/10 query repeats.
Shared input proves query/read comparability only; it does not measure or repair original import.

premeasurement_space_amendment.output_filesystem: /tmp; 8.8GiB filesystem, 4.5GiB free at registration; both private native clones and all Kuzu working databases are on this same filesystem
premeasurement_space_amendment.original_input: Immutable source remains on /workspace; cloning/preparation is outside query timers. No storage-device-equivalence claim to previous window.
